claim.claim-text: 1. A vehicle cleaner system configured to clean a cleaning target object, comprising:

a cleaner configured to spray a cleaning medium onto a cleaning target surface of the cleaning target object and to clean the cleaning target surface; and a cleaner control unit (2116) configured to operate the cleaner on the cleaning target surface which includes a plurality of regions (R1-R3), so as to make cleaning strength for at least one of the plurality of regions different from cleaning strength for other regions.

2. The vehicle cleaner system according to claim 1, wherein a difference in the cleaning strength includes at least one of differences in a number of times of spray, a spray time, a spray amount, a spray pressure and a spray area of the cleaning medium.

3. The vehicle cleaner system according to claim 1 or 2, further comprising a dirt detection unit (2130) configured to detect which region among the plurality of regions is dirty, wherein the cleaner control unit (2116) is configured to change the cleaning strength in accordance with output of the dirt detection unit.
4. The vehicle cleaner system according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the plurality of regions are configured by regions divided in a left-right direction of the cleaning target surface.
5. The vehicle cleaner system according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein

the cleaner includes a nozzle (2103) which includes at least one opening portion (2103A) configured to spray the cleaning medium, and a direction of the at least one opening portion is changeable so as to face each of the plurality of regions.
6. The vehicle cleaner system according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein

the cleaner includes a nozzle (2203) which includes a plurality of opening portions (2203A,2203B,2203C) configured to spray the cleaning medium, and the plurality of opening portions are disposed so as to correspond to each of the plurality of regions.
7. The vehicle cleaner system according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein

the cleaner includes a plurality of nozzles (2303A,2303B,2303C) configured to spray the cleaning medium, and the plurality of nozzles are disposed on at least three sides of the cleaning target object: left side, right side and upper side.
